blind_spots.blind_spot: Public materials sell propulsor performance specs (thrust, noise, speed) with no mention of battery/charging logistics or spares tail for an electric system deployed OCONUS.
blind_spots.operator_reality: An E-5 sustaining a CLA aircraft at an austere site needs battery logistics, charging infrastructure, and field-replaceable spares — none of that is addressed alongside the '20% more efficient / 20 dB quieter' spec sheet.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company culture is propulsion-engineering-first (aerodynamics, acoustics); sustainment planning for the full aircraft system is a downstream concern typically owned by the airframe integrator, not yet visible in their own materials.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 5–500 lbs Scalable thrust / 20 dB Quieter / 40 to 400 kts Speed

blind_spots.blind_spot: Open roles show a general 'Head of IT/Security' hire but nothing RMF/ATO/ISSO-titled, despite pursuing a DoD Collaborative Logistics Aircraft program that will need its own accreditation path for onboard avionics/flight computer.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Propulsor hardware clearing DoD test doesn't get the CLA onto a government network or into a program of record — the flight computer and any data links need a separate RMF/ATO track that a generic IT/security hire won't own.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team composition (structures, mechanical test, aerothermal, CNC) skews hardware-manufacturing, suggesting the software/avionics compliance function is still nascent relative to the propulsion IP.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The customer-facing pitch is entirely to OEMs and airframe partners — no description of who trains or sustains the CLA once it's in a unit's hands.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Winning the airframe integration deal is not the same as an operator-level advocacy chain; without a champion above the pilot/loadmaster level describing training and field support, a successful SOF Week demo can still die in transition.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company is mid-pivot from a consumer/commercial RAM narrative (regional air mobility, passenger travel) to a DoD contested-logistics narrative, and the sustainment story hasn't caught up to the new DoD-specific product line.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: We're looking for airframe partners to make regional air mobility a reality. OEMs, look no further.

opener_hook: Whisper Aero's Collaborative Logistics Aircraft is slated for 2027 flight testing — the propulsor spec sheet is public, but the RMF path for the onboard flight computer isn't.
what_they_do: Electric ducted-fan propulsion (UltraQuiet propulsors) for drones and, now, a DoD contested-logistics cargo aircraft (Collaborative Logistics Aircraft).
